title: SMTP Send Overall Deadline
description: The email module shall bound every outbound SMTP send operation with a finite overall deadline.
rationale: Even after a successful TCP connection a slow or throttled SMTP server can stall the DATA or QUIT phase indefinitely; an overall send deadline ensures the entire send operation — including authentication, data transfer, and completion — fails fast rather than blocking the HTTP request path for an unbounded duration. The concrete bound is an implementation detail recorded in the design; the requirement mandates only that a finite deadline exists.
